name: Buckler
description: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Bandit class.
Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc in Stormveil Castle for 1,500 Runes.
lore: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center is designed to parry.
A well-timed parry deflects an enemy's attack, breaking their stance and leaving them open to a critical hit. Though risk is inherent, this shield favors aggression.
Unique Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance. This is faster than a regular parry.

name: Perfumer's Shield
description: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by shield-wielding Perfumers and Depraved Perfumers.
lore: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service.
Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.

name: Man-serpent's Shield
description: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor.
lore: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir.
Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.

name: Pillory Shield
description: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such. Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.
obtain: Looted from a corpse inside one of the locked cells within the Gaol Cave in Caelid.
lore: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such.
Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.

name: Rickety Shield
description: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Prophet class.
2% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding Demi-Humans.
lore: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines.
There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

name: Beastman's Jar-shield
description: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it. The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding beastmen in Crumbling Farum Azula.
lore: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it.
The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.

name: Red Thorn Roundshield
description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Samurai class.
Can be bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Castle Morne Rampart) for 600 Runes.
lore: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield.
Its emblem is an ancient thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.

name: Riveted Wooden Shield
description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Warrior class.
Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in east Limgrave for 600 Runes.
lore: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield.
The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.

name: Scripture Wooden Shield
description: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Astrologer class.
2% chance to be dropped by the Skeletons wielding a Scimitar and Iron Roundshield.
lore: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield.
An ancient cipher engraving lines the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

name: Blue-white Wooden Shield
description: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design is said to represent the stars of the night sky, portending fate.
obtain: Found behind a building in Academy Gate Town, in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield.
The design is said to represent the stars of the night sky, portending fate.

name: Rift Shield
description: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Prisoner class.
Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church in Liurnia of the Lakes for  1800 Runes.
lore: Small metal roundshield depicting a sinister rift.
An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.

name: Iron Roundshield
description: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.
obtain: Sold for 900 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant southeast of the Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.
lore: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.

name: Smoldering Shield
description: Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava. Resists frost with its heat, and can even be used to deal fire damage if wielded as a weapon.
obtain: Looted from a corpse in an low area filled with explosive Living Jars within Volcano Manor.
lore: Small shield made upon Mt. Gelmir forged from uncooling lava.
Resists frost with its heat, and can even be used to deal fire damage if wielded as a weapon.

name: Gilded Iron Shield
description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.
obtain: Found on a corpse in the graveyard outside the Church of Pilgrimage on the Weeping Peninsula.
lore: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.

name: Ice Crest Shield
description: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. The ice crest originates from a Carian princess. Thogh the effect is slight, it boosts magic damage negation and resistance to frost.
obtain: Looted from a corpse on a rock formation in the lowest level of Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
The ice crest originates from a Carian princess. Though the effect is slight, it boosts magic damage negation and resistance to frost.

name: Spiralhorn Shield
description: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss. Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.
obtain: Found on a corpse on a ledge to the northwest of the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace in the Uld Palace Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss.
Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.

name: Marred Leather Shield
description: Leather shield of Stormveil soldiers. Miuch like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.
obtain: Looted from a corpse on the wooden stairs along the exterior wall past the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.
lore: Leather shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns.
Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

name: Marred Wooden Shield
description: "Wooden shield of the Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle."
obtain: Stormveil Castle, near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, by jumping over the crenellations in the area with the Warhawks perched on barrels and dropping down the rampart walls to jutting ledges on the outside cliff.
lore: Wooden shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns.
Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

name: Coil Shield
description: An extremely odd shield adorned with a coiled bronze snake. An excellent choice for attention-seekers. This Shield provides an effective defense against poison - after all, how does one poison a poisonous snake?
obtain: Found on a corpse within one of the tunnel rooms in Volcano Cave on Mt. Gelmir. Take the tunnel to the right of the chamber past the grace and drop down the ledge to find the tunnel to the shield.
lore: Armament designed for gladiatorial combat. Rises above its peers as a particularly showy specimen.
The sculpted bronze snake is a poisonous breed, boosting the wielder's resistance to poison.
Unique Skill: Viper Bite
Give the shield a quick shake to temporarily bring the bronze viper to life, inciting it to lash out and bite foes.

name: Kite Shield
description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.
obtain: Purchased for 1,000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant by the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in southern Liurnia of the Lakes or from the Twin Maiden Husks upon giving them his bell bearing.
lore: A standard medium-sized metal shield.
Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

name: Banished Knight's Shield
description: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
obtain: 4% chance to drop from various shield-wielding Banished Knights.
lore: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.
Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

name: Albinauric Shield
description: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by shield-wielding young Albinaurics.
lore: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created.
Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.

name: Sun Realm Shield
description: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped from various Skeleton Knights who carry it.
lore: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days.
Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.

name: Silver Mirrorshield
description: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric.
obtain: Found inside the Apostate Derelict, located in Consecrated Snowfield.
lore: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.
The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric.

name: Round Shield
description: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.
obtain: Bought for  1000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant at  Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them his Bell Bearing.
lore: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal.
Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.

name: Scorpion Kite Shield
description: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.
obtain: Purchased for  2,000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant near the  Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in Altus Plateau or from the Twin Maiden Husks upon giving them his Bell Bearing.
lore: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability.
Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.

name: Twinbird Kite Shield
description: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds. At dwindling levels of HP, this shield slightly boosts both attack and defense.
obtain: Dropped by the Deathbird that you encounter at night north of the Leyndell, Royal Capital, northeast of the Hermit Merchant's shack in the Capital Outskirts.
lore: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds.
At dwindling levels of HP, this shield slightly boosts both attack and defense.

name: Blue-gold Kite Shield
description: A standard medium-sized shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foreground against a blue sky.
obtain: Purchased for 1,000 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave south of the Minor Erdtree or from the Twin Maiden Husks upon giving them his Bell Bearing.
lore: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability.
The design represents the Erdtree foregrounded against a blue sky.

name: Brass Shield
description: On the larger side for medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass. Commonly employed in the Shattering.
obtain:
2% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding Soldiers across factions.
1.5% chance to be dropped by various shield-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers.
lore: On the larger side for medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass.
Commonly employed in the Shattering.

name: Shield Of The Guilty
description: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands. Venerating the repose of the soul, this shield boosts focus. The briars can be used to attack foes.
obtain:
Location: Demi-Human Forest Ruins
The Shield of the Guilty is found in a chest in the cellar of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula. The cellar entrance will be visible behind in a hole in a wall behind some branches; however, you will need to jump into the building section to enter.
lore: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands.
Venerating the repose of the soul, this shield boosts focus. The briars can be used to attack foes.
Shield covered in sharp spikes, depicting the image of a goddess.
Can also be used as a weapon, as the spikes cause severe hemorrhaging.
loreNotes: This item was titled Sinner's Shield and had a different description in .
The goddess could be the Fell God, Gloam-Eyed Queen, Marika, Melina, Demi-Human Queen, or someone else.

name: Great Turtle Shell
description: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks. The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed.
obtain: Found in the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise. Reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant, jumping towards the tower.
lore: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks.
The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed.

name: Carian Knight's Shield
description: A teardrop-shaped shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family. Excels when facing magic or holy attacks. Just who were these knights preparing to fight?
obtain: Dropped by Moongrum, Carian Knight.
lore: A teardrop-shaped, medium-sized shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family.
Excels when facing magic or holy attacks. Just who were these knights preparing to fight?
loreNotes: This item was originally called "Carian Glintstone Shield" in the Closed Network Test. It also had "Sorcerer Hunter" as its innate skill, which became the Skill: Carian Retaliation.

name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.
obtain: Purchased for 1,000 Runes from Patches in Murkwater Cave or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Patches' Bell Bearing.
lore: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle.
The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.

name: Candletree Wooden Shield
description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Thought to represent a surreptitious prophecy of cardinal sin, the lit candle-tree design was forbidden.
obtain:
Location: Sage's Cave
Found in a chest hidden behind an illusory wall in Sage's Cave.
lore: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle.
Thought to represent a surreptitious prophecy of cardinal sin, the lit candle-tree design was forbidden.

name: Large Leather Shield
description: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Hero class.
Purchased for 600 Runes from Kalé, or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Kalé's Bell Bearing.
lore: A roundshield covered in leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield.
Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle a wider range of attack affinities.
loreNotes: This item was originally just called "Leather Shield" in the Closed Network Test.

name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy. The yellow flame is the symbol of the affliction, serving as a warning to those who might approach the village.
obtain:
Location: Ailing Village
Found on a corpse in one of the cabins at the Ailing Village in the Weeping Peninsula region.
lore: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy.
The yellow flame is the symbol of the affliction, serving as a warning to those who might approach the village.

name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
description: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Adorned with a long-forgotten crest of Stormveil, ancient in design.
obtain: Found in Stormveil Castle, in a room that requires a Stonesword Key to open, near the Grafted Scion and the elevator shortcut back up the the Ramparts Site of Grace.
lore: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle.
Adorned with a long-forgotten crest of Stormveil, ancient in design.

name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. Features a beast as its crest, serving to remind warriors not to succumb to the arousal of battle. Fight with passion, but become nor its prisoner.
obtain: In a chest at a Godrick Knight's camp northeast of the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill.
lore: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
Features a beast as its crest, serving to remind warriors not to succumb to the arousal of battle. Fight with passion, but become not its prisoner.

name: Red Crest Heater Shield
description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.
obtain: Purchased for  2500 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant near the  Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace on Altus Plateau.
lore: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
The crest symbolizes red wings.

name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The sun in eclipse is said to be the symbol of the Wandering Mausoleum where the soulless demigods slumber.
obtain: Found on a corpse atop a large stone archway protruding from a cliff northwest of the Minor Erdtree in the Weeping Peninsula.
lore: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
The sun in eclipse is said to be the symbol of the Wandering Mausoleum where the soulless demigods slumber.

name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.
obtain:
Starting gear for the Confessor class.
Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church for  1500 Runes.
lore: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
The crest represents a forest and river.

name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
description: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The inverted hawk is the emblem of the company of slaves ordered to explore the Eternal City.
obtain: Obtained in Siofra River, on a hill near the steps leading to Hallowhorn Grounds.
lore: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.
The inverted hawk is the emblem of the company of slaves ordered to explore the Eternal City.

name: Heater Shield
description: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.
obtain:
Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,500 Runes.
Starting equipment of the Vagabond class.
lore: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle.
Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

name: Black Leather Shield
description: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.
obtain: Bought for 2,500 Runes from Pidia, Carian Servant or by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Pidia's Bell Bearing.
lore: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield.
From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.

name: Dragon Towershield
description: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.
obtain: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula, guarded by a Banished Knight. From the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace, proceed down to the open area with the already wounded ancient dragon. Drop down a set of ledges to the dragon's left, enter the building and climb a ladder to find the chest.
lore: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even among greatshields, it possesses exceptional guarding ability.
The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.

name: Crucible Hornshield
description: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn. An ancient holiness dwells within. The crucible horn skewers foes when performing shield bashes.
obtain: The Crucible Hornshield is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight at the Siofra Aqueduct, near the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs site of grace.
lore: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn.
An ancient holiness dwells within. The crucible horn skewers foes when performing shield bashes.

name: Distinguished Greatshield
description: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.
obtain:
Location: Hermit Merchant's Shack
Purchased from the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts for  5,500 runes.
lore: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families.
Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

name: Dragonclaw Shield
description: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Edrtree. Imbued with lightning.
obtain: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss in Altus Plateau, outside Leyndell, Royal Capital.
lore: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree.
Imbued with lightning.

name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
description: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greratshields, and subsequently easier to wield. The beast depicted is Serosh, aged counselor who guides the golden lineage.
obtain: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation. If you are not able to defeat it during your first visit, you can reattempt the fight later by going through the "Precipice of Anticipation" sending gate at the Four Belfries.
lore: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greatshields, and subsequently easier to wield.
The beast depicted is Serosh, aged counselor who guides the golden lineage.

name: Erdtree Greatshield
description: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection. The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.
obtain: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo in Altus Plateau at the southern entrance to the Capital Outskirts.
lore: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection.
The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.
Unique Skill: Golden Retaliation
Ready the shield to unleash its protective incantation. This will dispel sorceries and incantations, retaliating with golden power.

name: Briar Greatshield
description: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame. Originates from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics.
obtain: Defeat Elemer of the Briar in the Shaded Castle.
lore: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame.
Originates from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics.
Rune-accursed greatshield arranged with iron thorns. Favored by the Rune Hunter Knights.
Slamming this shield into an enemy is sure to cause hemorrhaging.

name: Jellyfish Shield
description: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield. The see-through head is extremely light, but its flesh is supple, providing absolutely no protection from piercing attacks
obtain: Found on a dead body with four Spirit Jellyfish around it, north of the  Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield.
The see-through head is extremely light, but its flesh is supple, providing absolutely no protection from piercing attacks.
Unique Skill: Contagious Fury
Incite the jellyfish's wrath and allow its fury to flow through you. Raises attack power for a certain duration.

name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
description: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields. Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.
obtain:
Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
The Fingerprint Stone Shield is found in the platforming segment past the Cathedral of the Forsaken that leads to the Frenzied Flame Proscription. It is guarded by a Nomad.
lore: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields.
Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.
loreNotes: This item's design is based on the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gavrinis Neolithic passage tomb at Gavrinis].
In 1.0, it is simply referred to as the tomb of an ancient lord, making the parallel even more blatant.

name: Icon Shield
description: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipients of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty. The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.
obtain: Looted from a corpse within the Woodfolk Ruins in Altus Plateau.
lore: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipience of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back fondly on the age of plenty.
The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.
loreNotes: The 1.0 version of the game preserves an earlier draft of this item description: A wooden shield depicting the Erdtree. Strongly retains the Rune of Life's blessing, providing gentle HP recovery when held.

name: Visage Shield
description: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth. The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.
obtain: It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest after defeating the Pumpkin Head duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.
lore: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mouth.
The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.
Unique Skill: Tongues of Fire
Ready the shield, then spray violent jets of fire from the tongues protruding from its maw. Hold to continue spraying fire. This skill can be used while walking.

name: One-eyed Shield
description: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth. Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.
obtain: Dropped by Chief Guardian Arghanthy at the Guardians' Garrison in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
lore: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth.
Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.
Unique Skill: Flame Spit
Ready the shield, then launch a fireball from the barrel. The fireball explodes on impact.

name: Spiked Palisade Shield
description: Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield"
obtain: Looted from a corpse at the feet of a Guardian Golem in the chasm northwest of the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid.
lore: A large wooden shield covered with spikes. Though relatively light, it lacks in damage negation.
Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield."

name: Manor Towershield
description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
obtain: Found in Stormveil Castle, from the Secluded Cell Site of Grace, head back towards the Living Jars, then follow the wall to the right upon reaching the next level up the ramp. The Tarnished must jump to the windows from the ledge and enter the door to the right afterward. Following this path will lead to a storeroom full of Commoners with the Manor Shield being under the stairs.
lore: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions.
Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Crossed-tree Towershield
description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel
obtain:
Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in Altus Plateau for 3800 Runes.
ru:Башенный щит со скрещёнными стволами
lore: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree.
Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Redmane Greatshield
description: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by Redmane Knights throughout Caelid.
lore: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion.
Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

name: Ant's Skull Plate
description: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repeling enemy attacks. Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding the shield.
obtain:
Nokstella, Eternal City
Can be found in a chest in a small room found just up the stairs from the city's main Site of Grace.
lore: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repelling enemy attacks.
Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding this shield.

name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
description: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
obtain: 1.00% chance to be dropped by greatshield-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers in Nokron, Eternal City.
lore: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest.
Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
loreNotes: Patches carrying this item is likely a nod to Maldron the Assassin from Dark Souls II.

name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
description: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights. The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay. No skill. This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by Mausoleum Knights near Wandering Mausoleums, in the Nameless Eternal City and outside the Black Knife Catacombs.
lore: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights.
The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay.

name: Cuckoo Greatshield
description: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by Cuckoo Knights throughout Liurnia of the Lakes.
lore: Metal greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy.
Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. "Our enemy is none other than Caria itself."

name: Gilded Greatshield
description: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by shield-wielding Godrick Knights, including the Bloodcrazed Knight at Fort Haight.
lore: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick.
The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

name: Golden Greatshield
description: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.
obtain: 4% chance to be dropped by Leyndell Knights throughout Altus Plateau and in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
lore: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell.
Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
description: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.
obtain: The Haligtree Crest Greatshield has a 4% chance to be dropped by a Haligtree Knight outside the chapel beyond the  Drainage Channel Site of Grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
lore: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation.
Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

name: Wooden Greatshield
description: Wooden greatshield reinforced with a metal ornamentation. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
obtain: In the guarded courtyard in Stormveil Castle, it's located in the guardhouse to the right if entering the area from the main gates, opposite side from the room with the "Prophecy" Painting.
lore: Wooden greatshield reinforced with a metal ornamentation.
Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Lordsworn's Shield
description: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
obtain: 2% chance to be dropped by various greatshield-wielding enemy soldiers, such as Godrick Soldiers.
lore: Wooden tower shield. Lightweight for a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering.
Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Black Steel Greatshield
description: Weighty shields carried by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Made of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Symbolic of their iron conviction in their crusade, the Black Knights will never yield. Nor will they ever doubt their purpose.
obtain:
Location: Fog Rift Fort
Dropped by Black Knight Garrew at the Fog Rift Fort, accessible from the Scadu Altus.
lore: Weighty shields carried by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Made of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.
Symbolic of their iron conviction in their crusade, the Black Knights will never yield. Nor will they ever doubt their purpose.

name: Carian Thrusting Shield
description: Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combat – a demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree.
obtain: Found on a corpse in the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse's back section, reached from the Church District. The shield is found by going past the tall ladder. It is guarded by a Fire Knight.
lore: Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.
Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combat – a demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree.

name: Dueling Shield
description: A thrusting shield of golden ornamentation which enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. In the realm of shadow, though far away from the Erdtree, ritual combat continued to hold weight.
obtain: Found on a corpse inside the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse. From the Site of Grace, proceed upstairs until you reach the original position of the feet of the humanoid specimen. Then, jump over the railing to the left to take a path to a ledge where the shield awaits.
lore: A thrusting shield of golden ornamentation which enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.
In the realm of shadow, though far away from the Erdtree, ritual combat continued to hold weight.

name: Golden Lion Shield
description: Shield made to resemble a fierce golden lion with a luxuriant mane. Awarded to especially valorous members of Radahn's personal guard on the occasion of its formation. Unique Skill: Roaring Bash Roar like a golden lion and deliver a shield bash from a guarding position. Knocks back and staggers foes over a wide radius.
obtain:
Location: Specimen Storehouse
Reward from Redmane Freyja after delivering her the Letter from Ansbach.
lore: Shield made to resemble a fierce golden lion with a luxuriant mane.
Awarded to especially valorous members of Radahn's personal guard on the occasion of its formation.
Unique Skill: Roaring Bash
Roar like a golden lion and deliver a shield bash from a guarding position. Knocks back and staggers foes over a wide radius.

name: Lamenting Visage
description: A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area. The unusual expression somehow imparts a sense of contentment. The languid ease of one who needs not sight. Unique Skill: Blindfold of Happiness Swing the head while covering the eyes, unleashing a wail of lamentation while temporarily making the user of this skill harder to see. To those who seek happiness, blindness is bliss.
obtain: Found on a corpse within the Lamenter's Gaol behind an illusory wall and a gate needing the Gaol Lower Level Key to unlock.
lore: A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.
The unusual expression somehow imparts a sense of contentment. The languid ease of one who needs not sight.
Unique Skill: Blindfold of Happiness
Swing the head while covering the eyes, unleashing a wail of lamentation while temporarily making the user of this skill harder to see. To those who seek happiness, blindness is bliss.

name: Messmer Soldier Shield
description: Worn roundshield carried by soldiers loyal to Messmer, the Impaler. The largest of all metal shields in their class.
lore: Worn roundshield carried by soldiers loyal to Messmer, the Impaler.
The largest of all metal shields in their class.

name: Nanaya's Torch
description: A torch made by attaching a dying flame of frenzy to a small spinal column. In a distant land, in an age long past, was born a man who failed to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame. All that remains of him is cradled gently by Nanaya. Unique Skill: Feeble Lord's Flame Hold torch out in front and spit out frenzied flame. Afflicts those caught in its area of effect with madness, along with the user themselves. The skill will continue for as long as the button is held down. Can be used while moving.
obtain:
Location: Midra's Manse
Nanaya's Torch is found in the arms of Nanaya, who sits in a chair on the upper balcony in the western wing of Midra's Manse.
lore: A torch made by attaching a dying flame of frenzy to a small spinal column.
In a distant land, in an age long past, was born a man who failed to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame. All that remains of him is cradled gently by Nanaya.
Unique Skill: Feeble Lord's Flame

Hold torch out in front and spit out frenzied flame. Afflicts those caught in its area of effect with madness, along with the user themselves. The skill will continue for as long as the button is held down. Can be used while moving.

name: Serpent Crest Shield
description: A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire. Said to have been made to commemorate the beginnings of the crusade started by Messmer, son of Marika.
obtain:
Quest: Gravesite Plain, Realm of Shadow
The Serpent Crest Shield is rewarded upon completing the "Incursion" Painting puzzle. Travel west from  Greatbridge North site of grace after receiving the item at the Artist's Shack (Gravesite Plain).
lore: A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire.
Said to have been made to commemorate the beginnings of the crusade started by Messmer, son of Marika.

name: Shield of Night
description: A shield awarded to Swordhands of Night, cast in a bottomless black from which no light can escape. The outer surface is only semicorporeal, providing reliable defense against attacks that are not physical in nature. Unique Skill: Revenge of the Night Unleashes the dark of Night imbued with magic power. If used immediately after blocking an incoming attack, its power is absorbed, bolstering the strength of this skill.
obtain: Found on a corpse within Bonny Gaol. Before the bridge leading to the drop down to the boss room, there is a jar elevator that leads up to a ledge where the shield can be found inside a broken cell.
lore: A shield awarded to Swordhands of Night, cast in a bottomless black from which no light can escape.
The outer surface is only semicorporeal, providing reliable defense against attacks that are not physical in nature.
Unique Skill: Revenge of the Night
Unleashes the dark of Night imbued with magic power. If used immediately after blocking an incoming attack, its power is absorbed, bolstering the strength of this skill.

name: Smithscript Shield
description: Roundshield engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Can be thrown by performing the armament's Skill. Unique Skill: Discus Hurl Throws the roundshield like a discus using the smithing arts. Once thrown, the shield will remain airbone for a moment before beginning a vertical rotation that chases down its target.
obtain: Found on a corpse in Taylew's Ruined Forge. After reaching the top of the pipe at its original position, jump over to the path leading to the lever, but instead climb the rubble in the room past the hallway to reach the shield. It is guarded by a Golem Smith.
lore: Roundshield engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
Can be thrown by performing the armament's Skill.
Unique Skill: Discus Hurl
Throws the roundshield like a discus using the smithing arts. Once thrown, the shield will remain airbone for a moment before beginning a vertical rotation that chases down its target.

name: Verdigris Greatshield
description: Greatshield made of the unusual metal known as verdigris. Boasts greater guard capacity than damage negation. To the extent that the shield will continue to protect its target even if its bearer should die. Unique Skill: Moore's Charge Ready the shield with both hands, then charge forth while maintaining guard, ending in a shove imbued with verdigris magic. Knocks back nearby enemies, but does not cause significant harm. Hold to extend the length of the charge.
obtain: Dropped by Moore upon his death, regardless of how he dies.
lore: Greatshield made of the unusual metal known as verdigris.
Boasts greater guard capacity than damage negation. To the extent that the shield will continue to protect its target even if its bearer should die.
Unique Skill: Moore's Charge

Ready the shield with both hands, then charge forth while maintaining guard, ending in a shove imbued with verdigris magic. Knocks back nearby enemies, but does not cause significant harm. Hold to extend the length of the charge.

name: Wolf Crest Shield
description: A finely-made "blueshield" featuring an engraving of a wolf under the moon. Excels at fending off sorceries. The wolf is the beast of the Carian royal covenant; a symbol of the moon's pride that none can forget, no matter what remote lands they may arrive in.
obtain:
Loot: Castle Ensis, Realm of Shadow
The Wolf Crest Shield is found on a corpse in Castle Ensis down the stairs to the right of the chapel entrance guarded by Moonrithyll.
lore: A finely-made "blueshield" featuring an engraving of a wolf under the moon. Excels at fending off sorceries.
The wolf is the beast of the Carian royal covenant; a symbol of the moon's pride that none can forget, no matter what remote lands they may arrive in.
